copy.headline: Fort Worth police searching for Erik Hernandez, wanted for murder
copy.caption:
Fort Worth police are looking for Erik Hernandez, wanted for murder. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
